fact: Decree 2023-1751 of 2 November 2023 creates the SIGE inside the ministry of preschool, primary, secondary education and literacy as a platform that registers each learner under a unique number and digitises grades, report cards and school record books, with data entry assigned to the schools (or their inspectorates); it is administered by the ministry's Direction des systèmes d'information et de la communication and maintained by the state agency ACSI.
system: Système d'information de gestion de l'éducation (SIGE)

fact: Decree 2023-1751 of 2 November 2023 provides that setting up and running the SIGE in public schools is financed by the State budget, gifts and legacies, and technical and financial partners, in private schools by a contribution from those schools, and that statistics and yearbooks are financed by the State budget; it names no amount or budget line.

fact: In May 2023 the Environnement Numérique de Travail for primary and secondary schools existed only as a specification written for MEPSA by an APPRENDRE (AUF) consultant; it foresees teachers keeping attendance, marks and appraisals per pupil, and no school was using it.

The May 2023 specification only proposes a trial from September 2023 in a few schools to be chosen by MEPSA, for example two primary schools and one secondary; no school had the ENT at the time of writing.

The ENT is specified for the ministry of primary and secondary education (MEPSA), whose directorate DSIC is to be equipped to build and run it, with the specification work supported by the AUF's APPRENDRE programme (May 2023).

The specification states that in May 2023 there was not yet an ICT policy for the education sector, that MEPSA had no well-structured digital information system, and that a master plan for its information and management system was only planned.
